title: Fraction Line Race: On Your Own
subject: math
instructions: Answer on your own. Write your ID number, not your name.

questions.skill: I can place fractions on a number line
questions.prompt: Mark It: Put a dot at 3/4 and a dot at 5/4 on the number line. Write each fraction above its dot.

diagram.description: A number line from 0 to 2 with a tick at every fourth; 0, 1, and 2 are labeled.

checklist.item: A dot at 3/4: the third tick after 0, before 1.
A dot at 5/4: the first tick after 1.

questions.prompt: Bigger Piece: Which is bigger, 1/8 or 1/4? Circle the letter.

options.why: Eighths are smaller pieces: 8 fit in one whole.
Yes: fourths are bigger pieces than eighths.
One eighth is half of one fourth.
Both are parts of the same whole.

questions.prompt: Equal Fractions: Fill in the boxes so the fractions are equal.
Meet at One Half: Which fraction sits at the same point as 1/2?

options.why: One twelfth is a tiny piece.

questions.prompt: Same Point? Are 3/4 and 6/8 at the same point on the number line? Explain how you know.
questions.key: Yes. Each fourth is two eighths, so 3 fourths is 6 eighths (or: both are 18 of the 24 marks). Full credit needs yes and a reason; yes alone is partial.
